posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body:
Hi, watering crops, treating crop diseases, or other mechanics that require player input mid-growth is not yet part of the [CGMZ] Gathering plugin.
The crops are disappearing because the event growing the crop is disappearing, which seems to be intentional as in the documentation for the plugin you are using to spawn the event it says events do not keep after map transfer in the basic version. While crops do grow in the background, [CGMZ] Gathering depends on the event being there to show / interact with the crop. If you have the pro version of Pocket Events it seems to be able to save events so they are there after map transfer, but as I do not use it myself I can't say for sure it works with [CGMZ] Gathering.
All CGMZ plugins are compatible with each other. [CGMZ] Day Night System does have the ability to run a common event when a day ends so you could add the [CGMZ] Gathering plugin command "Advance Every Node" to advance the stage of every gathering node once per day at day end that way. To get the crops to not automatically grow, you can set the growth time to 0 (infinite) for each stage.
